result.title: ILLRAW: Illumination-Aware RAW Object Detection
result.summary: Existing RAW-based detectors typically introduce learnable ISP modules to convert RAW inputs into sRGB-like formats to fit off-the-shelf detectors. However, this RAW-to-sRGB paradigm decouples representation learning from the downstream detection task. Crucially, it forces the network to inherit human-centric visual priors while discarding intrinsic RAW advantages, such as linear sensor responses and high-bit-depth, minimally processed scene cues. In this paper, we propose \textbf{ILLRAW}, an \textbf{ILL}umination-aware end-to-end \textbf{RAW} object detection framework. Instead of reconstructing visually plausible sRGB images, ILLRAW directly learns detection-oriented RAW features through a lightweight feature adapter inserted at the input stage of existing detectors. ILLRAW estimates an illumination mask and introduces channel-sensitive embeddings to model Bayer-channel responses. These features are fused by an illumination attention fusion module. Experiments show clear improvements on the diverse AODRaw benchmark and competitive performance on LOD and PascalRAW, with particularly strong results under dark exposure.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 ILLRAW，一种光照感知的端到端 RAW 目标检测框架：用插入检测器输入端的轻量特征适配器取代 RAW→sRGB 的 ISP 重建，结合光照掩码、通道敏感嵌入与光照注意力融合直接学习面向检测的 RAW 特征，在 AODRaw 上提升明显、暗光曝光下尤其突出。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「放弃 sRGB 重建、保留高比特线性传感器线索」的主张可能与 LVR 中视觉证据如何在内部表示中保真、避免重建式瓶颈的问题相通，可供核查；但论文本身属目标检测任务，未涉及 latent 推理状态、证据筛选或停止决策。
